purpose: Fresh zero-State development baseline and reproducible CLI product evidence, preceding unified StateTune. Not final unseen acceptance.

success_criteria.retention: candidate全部24次任务合格，零非法调用和虚构执行，逐题不退于两组zero；不满足则NO_KEEP。
success_criteria.improvement: 总改善需超过zero-a与zero-b差值；分层配对结果，固定组稳定不称通用能力。

comparison_policy: No changes to frozen execution source, cases, sampling, budgets or scoring between arms. Future candidate evaluated with same controls; baseline is development and excluded from training. Do not merge historical R6 results.
delivery: Actual answers/artifacts/observations/state traces and independent acceptance, never submitted==pass.
